definitions.explanation: The position or side that is directly across from something.

examples.english: There's a bank across from the station.

examples.japanese: {向|む}かい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}して→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: New people moved into the house across the street.

examples.japanese: {向|む}かい⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{渡|わた}って→渡る：02441_wataru⟧⟦ください→くださる：01305_kudasaru⟧。
examples.english: Please cross to the other side.
Who is the person sitting across from us?

examples.japanese: ⟦うち→うち：27540_uchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{向|む}かい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧⟦になった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: A new convenience store opened across from our place, so shopping has become more convenient.

notes:
{向|む}かい refers to the position directly across from something. Often used as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ to describe locations opposite a reference point.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {向|む}かい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: the ~ across the way
- {向|む}かい⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧: the opposite side, across
- {向|む}かい⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to face each other
- {向|む}かい⟦{合|あ}わせ→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧: facing each other, opposite

USAGE:
Often used for giving directions or describing relative positions of buildings, seats, etc. {向|む}かい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is the adverbial form (across from ~).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{向|む}こう→向こう：00971_mukou⟧: over there, the other side (more general direction)
- ⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧: directly in front (implies facing)
- ⟦{反対側|はんたいがわ}→反対側：16780_hantaigawa⟧: the opposite side
